name: 1550 nm SNSPD system detection-efficiency and timing characterization at 2.5 K (NASA 2018)
plain_name: Measure the efficiency and timing of a cryogenic photon detector
description: Measure the efficiency and timing of a cryogenic photon detector. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Vyhnalek, Tedder and Nappier (2018), Performance and characterization of a modular superconducting nanowire single photon detector system for space-to-Earth optical communications links

requirements.rationale: Use the published2.5 K detector operating point. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
The cold instrument must contain functional superconducting nanowires and bias/readout. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Output pulses require external time-correlated counting. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

Efficiency measurement needs a calibrated incident photon flux, not an uncalibrated animation. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: Bias-current limits, polarization, dark/background counts, input attenuation and detector-specific calibration must be reviewed. Efficiency and jitter are measured results, not guaranteed compatibility outputs.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
